scope: Actual emitted opt2 sampling-profile Core, frozen old JYR2 battle payload. Three fresh VMs: inactive window, VM probes, then function sampling plus probes. Diagnostic attribution only; not a production/FPS acceptance run.

ci.parity_scope: Explicit tests/host-parity-project; 5 compared frames/checkpoints per variant, audio omission detected. No browser visual acceptance/default extra physics fixture claim.
ci.provenance: Read-only GitHub connector run/jobs, completed decoded baseline/candidate job logs and artifact metadata; candidate ZIP locally rehashed/extracted. Baseline/core archive bytes were not downloaded by this recorder.

extraction.policy: 100MiB total uncompressed bound; candidate-only relative paths; no traversal/backslashes/drive syntax/casefold duplicates/symlinks; file suffix allowlist log/json/js/wasm; exclusive file creation; no native executable extraction.

protocol.command_timer_scope: Complete await official core.execute(tick), including input admission, Core tick ABI, host restoration and dispatch. Per-frame digest checks occur after timing; full final canonical comparisons and profile query occur afterward.
protocol.mode_interpretation: All modes use the same diagnostic-capable sampler binary. OFF is not a separate production binary or a trustworthy production cost counterpart. Modes and sequential order may affect timing/GC schedules.
protocol.concurrent_load: Other chats/system activity not isolated; a feed-module unit test/Web test workload may have overlapped. Raw mode wall differences are descriptive, not causal overhead estimates.

execution.limitation: Eligibility is not per-function compilation proof. Preview diagnostics disable Luau codegen. Ordinary preview uses bytecode optimization 1; sampling-profile retains optimization 2 with safe-point/VM probes, whose overhead and optimized/inlined attribution require a separate unsampled comparison. Phase-profile takes precedence and uses optimization 2 without function or VM allocation/GC callbacks. Non-preview VMs default to optimization 2, including interpreters and Wasm. Source directives and cached job bytecode can differ. Wasm host JIT does not imply a Luau-to-Wasm JIT backend; pair diagnosis with unsampled production-mode replay.

modes.off_counter_availability: Profiling window disabled; zero raw counters do not mean zero allocation/GC.
modes.heap_scope: Passive current allocated bytes when the final profile report is queried; not a window peak or reachable/live heap.

function_metadata.semantics: VM-safe-point sample counts, not exact function milliseconds or call counts. Native calls and GC are not asynchronously sampled. Short functions, inlining and safe-point placement can bias attribution; compare with sampling disabled.

interpretation: The11 previously identified slow frames have multi-megabyte positive allocation-growth bursts and elevated same-frame incremental-step sums. That supports allocation/automatic-assist correlation; it does not count collector cycles or prove all slow-frame causes.

For example, probes frame135:14.4478ms full command,3,364,803 positive-growth bytes,2.413504ms summed incremental steps,max single0.0275ms. Frame151:14.3776ms,3,242,872bytes,2.133886ms sum,max single0.0525ms. These sums are not an isolated OS/GC pause measure or a complete explanation of command wall.

Top window-wide stacks point to background settlement NPC path planning and repeated snapshots/observations. The captured stack map has no per-frame assignment; do not label these as exact per-slow-frame function timings.
No claim is made about a later/current JYRogue build; every function and cadence here belongs to the explicitly pinned old R2 payload.
limits: OFF is the same sampling-capable artifact with profiling window inactive; it is not an ordinary production artifact. Raw OFF zero counters are unavailable observations, not zero allocation or GC.
Probes/sampling active VM counters cover Luau update including engine callbacks. Positive allocator growth is cumulative requests, not live heap, frees, Rust allocation or JavaScript allocation.
Incremental GC interrupt timing includes instrumentation/host scheduling overhead and excludes full collections. Per-frame overlap does not establish all GC causes or OS pause time.

Function counts are biased safe-point samples, not exact function milliseconds or call counts. Opt2 inlining, short functions and native bindings are not fully attributed; preserve dropped/truncated/sample metadata.
Three fixed-order runs do not establish causal performance improvement. Concurrent chats/machine work may overlap; no exclusive-window/FPS claim.
Only digest strings and frame scalars are checked after each timed command; full final World/UI/save encoding and profile report happen after timing.
WASM linear-memory capacity is not live memory, allocation growth, GC frequency or leak proof. No forced collection, replacement API, renderer or Native executable is used.

incremental_gc_steps counts instrumented incremental step/assist interrupts, never full collector cycles or collection frequency. Full-GC wall time is unsupported/null; JS GC and Rust allocation are outside these probes.
Positive requested allocator growth is cumulative growth traffic, not retained/live heap or WASM capacity. Do not relabel98.4MB as a live-memory footprint.
The largest single incremental step is distinct from the per-frame sum of many steps; neither establishes maximum application pause or OS scanout timing.
All3modes use the same sampler binary. No production-ABI counterfactual or causal profiler overhead estimate is claimed, particularly under possible concurrent unit/Web work.
No Game source, accepted9c artifact, production renderer, native executable, OS policy or clock was changed.
